decision.scope: recorded development default for accuracy and input coverage; not production or latency certification
decision.text: Use s19 as the recorded development default for accuracy and input coverage. Its owner-equivalent local-proxy mean is 0.513497 across 60 deduplicated logs, compared with 0.110450 for v4, 0.118445 for baseline DINO and 0.132779 for S23. All 46 DEV logs lack native v4 legend entries, so coverage dominates this complete-pipeline result; it does not show that the s19 matcher is intrinsically better than DINO. S23 leads the 13-log Viridien suite at 0.564399, but its paired margin over baseline DINO has a confidence interval that crosses zero. Keep the separate suite results, QA limits, formal Shenzi timeout, cache history and runtime scopes in view. No untested hybrid or held-out champion is declared. The later 600-second whole-attempt cap does not certify the new 1–2 minute evaluation goal or production readiness. The separate 120-second speed gate and live cache pilot are outside this matrix.
